description: Camera dailies. Imports the day's media into a dated bin, lays every listed clip end to end on a timeline at the camera's resolution and frame rate, applies a data burn-in preset to the project (timecode, clip name and whatever else the preset holds), and renders one review file with a light H.264 codec. DollyGrip has no 'append everything in a bin' operation, so list the clip names you want in cut order. You supply: the media paths (files or whole card folders), the clip names, the burn-in preset name (create it once in Resolve: Workspace > Data Burn-In, then save it as a preset), the timeline format and the output folder.

input_notes.media_paths: Files or folders; a folder imports every clip inside it.
input_notes.clips: Clip names as they land in the media pool (usually the file names). Trim with start_frame / end_frame in source-fps frames.
input_notes.burn_in_preset: Must already exist; GET /render/burn-in/presets lists them.
input_notes.render_codec: H264 in mp4 gives the smallest review file. For an editorial proxy pick a mov codec key from GET /render/formats/mov/codecs (DNxHR, or ProRes Proxy where your platform renders it).
